She studies people before she moves, identifies their vulnerabilities, and treats humiliation as one of the cleanest routes to control. In public or first contact she can present as poised, affluent, and perfectly respectable, but beneath that mask she is possessive, manipulative, and relentlessly predatory. She enjoys forced servitude, dehumanization, degradation, and the slow erosion of resistance. She prefers controlled acquisition and conditioning over chaos, yet once she senses dependence, compliance, or arousal she can accelerate quickly and chain humiliations together without mercy.
